app.name: AgriSense
app.tagline: Check your tomato and potato leaves
app.waking_server: Starting the server, this can take up to a minute the first time…
app.offline_banner: You are offline. Checks will be saved and sent later.
app.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
home.kcc_help: Need help? Call Kisan Call Centre (free)
capture.title: Take a photo of one leaf
capture.tip_one_leaf: One leaf only, filling the frame
capture.tip_daylight: In daylight, not in direct harsh sun
capture.tip_focus: Hold steady so the photo is sharp
capture.location_ask: We use your location only for the weather and soil forecast.
capture.location_denied: Location is off, so weather risk can't be checked. Pick your district:
capture.location_using_gps: Using your location for the weather forecast.
capture.location_using_district: GPS is off. Using {{name}} district for the weather forecast.
capture.saved_offline: Saved. It will be checked when you are online.
quality.too_blurry: The photo is blurry. Hold the phone steady and tap to focus.
quality.too_dark: The photo is too dark. Move to daylight.
quality.too_bright: The photo is too bright. Avoid direct sun on the leaf.
quality.no_leaf: We could not find a leaf. Fill the frame with one leaf.
quality.unknown: The photo could not be used. Please take it again.
result.title: Result
result.uncertain_body: These are the closest matches. Please confirm with an expert.
result.unsupported: This does not look like a tomato or potato leaf
result.unsupported_body: AgriSense only checks tomato and potato leaves. For other crops, call the Kisan Call Centre.
result.wrong_crop: This leaf may be from a different crop than the one you chose.
result.offline_note: Checked on your phone without internet. It will be checked again by the server when you are online.
result.disclaimer: This is a guide, not a lab test. Ask your local agriculture officer before spraying.
report.title: Leaf check report
report.not_ready: The report is ready once the check has a result.
risk.title: Late blight risk (next 3 days)
soil.title: Soil
soil.irrigation.wait_for_rain: Rain is expected. Wait before watering.
soil.irrigation.no_action: Soil moisture is fine. No action needed.
climate.title: This season vs normal
climate.rain_detail: {{now}} mm so far, normal is {{normal}} mm
climate.source: Source: Open-Meteo (ERA5). Normal = {{baseline}} average for the same dates.
queue.title: Your checks
schemes.title: Government schemes
schemes.empty: Schemes will appear when you are online.
settings.title: Settings
settings.location_help: We use GPS when it's on. If GPS is off or blocked, we use this district for the blight forecast and soil moisture.
settings.soil_card_help: Enter values from your card to get soil warnings.
settings.clear_confirm: Delete all saved checks from this phone?
locfix.title: Add your location
locfix.help: This check was made without location, so weather risk and soil were not checked. Pick your district to add them.
locfix.failed: Couldn't get the weather right now. Try again in a minute.
gradcam.title: Where the disease shows
gradcam.alt: Leaf photo with a heatmap over the parts that look diseased
gradcam.help: Red and yellow areas are the parts of the leaf the check focused on.
gradcam.demo: Demo heatmap: it marks brown and yellow patches until the trained model is added.
home.desktop_hint: Take a clear photo of one leaf, or upload one from your computer. You'll get a diagnosis, weather risk and what to do next.
install.title: Install AgriSense on this device
install.help: Opens like an app from your home screen, full screen, and works without internet. No app store needed.
install.ios_steps: On iPhone: tap the Share button (square with an arrow) at the bottom of Safari, then tap "Add to Home Screen".
